To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have identified a novel mechanism of angiogenesis in HCC, which involves the activation of HIF-1alpha and VEGF by the interaction of HCC cells with the ECM.
the expression of VEGF, its receptors and their ligands are upregulated in cirrhosis and in HCC.
The expression of the VEGFR1 and VEGFR2 was significantly increased in the liver cirrhosis, while VEGFR2 expression was decreased in the HCC.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of VEGF in angiogenesis in liver cirrhotic and hepatocellular carcinomas, and the role of VHL in the regulation of VEGF.
the development and characterization of a novel class of polymeric materials, the so-called poly(2-oxazoline)s.

the study of the molecular mechanisms involved in the development of angiogenesis in liver cirrhotic patients with or without hepatocellular carcinoma and in the study of the role of the angiogenesis inhibitors in the treatment of liver cirrhosis.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
angiogenesis is a common and essential feature of both liver cirrhosis as well as HCC and that angiogenesis in liver cirrhotics is associated with a higher risk of developing HCC.
angiogenesis is a key event in the pathogenesis of HCC.
the use of sildenafil in patients with erectile dysfunction and cardiovascular disease is not only safe but also effective, with the same efficacy as in patients without cardiovascular disease.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the development of hepatocellular carcinoma is a multistep procedure that involves the activation of angiogenesis.

the liver is a very dynamic organ, which can adapt to many different types of insults and injuries, and that this adaptability is the reason for the liver’s ability to regenerate and to maintain homeostasis.
the expression of VEGF, HIF-1, and CD31 is up-regulated in HCC, and VEGF expression correlates with the stage of liver fibrosis and the grade of HCC.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the angiogenic process is a dynamic one that is regulated by the interplay between pro-angiogenic and anti-angiogenic molecules.
the use of a 3D model of liver cancer can be used to screen drugs for their anti-cancer effects.
the use of the anti-angiogenic agent sunitinib in the setting of advanced hepatocellular carcinoma is safe and feasible, and may have a role in the treatment of this disease.
